name: dev.jobspipe/mcp
title: JobsPipe
description: Live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards, one schema. Sign in with OAuth from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients; a Bearer key works for scripts.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth (the default for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Codex). For a script or a client without sign-in, send "Bearer jp_live_<key>" - create a free key at https://jobspipe.dev/signup.
